\section{1. Executive findings}




\subsection{Main finding}




The public profile landscape confirms that Alexander’s positioning is coherent if expressed as:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Real-Time 3D Developer / Unity Technical Artist
\end{mdcode}




with strong supporting keywords:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Unity · C# · Unity WebGL · Technical Visualization · CAD-to-Realtime · Blender · Interactive 3D · Simulation · XR · Digital Twin
\end{mdcode}




The strongest comparable profiles tend to cluster around one of five families:




\begin{enumerate}
\item \textbf{Unity Technical Artist}
\item \textbf{Real-Time 3D / Interactive 3D Developer}
\item \textbf{Unity WebGL Developer}
\item \textbf{XR / Simulation / Digital Twin Developer}
\item \textbf{Unity Tools / Pipeline Developer}
\end{enumerate}




\subsection{Key implication}




Alexander should not market himself as a generic Unity developer. The benchmark shows that more differentiated profiles combine Unity with a domain:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Unity + Technical Art
Unity + WebGL
Unity + XR
Unity + Simulation
Unity + Digital Twin
Unity + Tools
Unity + Optimization
\end{mdcode}




TwinSight gives a stronger niche than generic gameplay.

\section{12. Gaps revealed by benchmark}




\subsection{Gap 1 — Public portfolio links}




Most comparable profiles likely have visible projects, but the search snippets did not expose them.




Alexander needs direct visible links:




\begin{itemize}
\item portfolio;
\item TwinSight demo;
\item GitHub;
\item ArtStation if used.
\end{itemize}




\subsection{Gap 2 — Industry wording}




The market uses short titles. Avoid academic phrasing.




Use:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Unity WebGL technical visualization prototype
\end{mdcode}




instead of:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Design Science Research artifact for cognitive support in drone assembly documentation
\end{mdcode}




Use the academic framing deeper in the case study, not in the headline.




\subsection{Gap 3 — Specialized proof}




For Technical Artist roles, current proof is strongest in:




\begin{itemize}
\item optimization;
\item pipeline;
\item visual modes;
\item Unity runtime;
\item UI;
\item technical visualization.
\end{itemize}




It is weaker in:




\begin{itemize}
\item advanced shaders;
\item Houdini;
\item VFX;
\item shipped game pipelines;
\item studio production tools.
\end{itemize}




\subsection{Gap 4 — XR}




XR appears frequently in comparable profiles. Alexander can target XR-adjacent roles, but should add one small XR or spatial-interaction artifact if XR becomes a serious target.




\subsection{Gap 5 — Digital twin}




Digital twin appears as a strong adjacent market. Alexander can use TwinSight as a \textbf{digital-twin-adjacent technical visualization} project, but should not claim production digital twin experience.
